parts:
Hi, I'm a newbie in biostatistics and proteomics (I'm also a french speaker so sorry in advance for my grammar mistakes). For my project, I have 47 run from 24 individuals (bioreplicates). I have 2 conditions (Young vs Old) and two technical replicates (Early vs Later).  My problem is : 

Error in .handleFractionsLF(input) : ** It is hard to find the same fractionation across sample, due to lots of overlapped features between fractionations. Please add Fraction column in input.

My data are not fractionned ; one sample is red in one run. Sometimes tought, I have more samples than one for some bioreplicates. For instance, one of my BioReplicate has 4 sample; 3 Early, 1 later. 

Where is my problem? Is it in my annotation file?

Alice F
